LanguageData.Anarchistes.label: Anarchists
LanguageData.Anarchistes.description: A group of anarchists with individual freedom as a fundamental value, their goal is the destruction of any state system. They refuse the principle of hierarchy, preferring self-management.
LanguageData.Anarchistes_feministes.label: Anarcho-feminists
LanguageData.Anarchistes_feministes.description: A group of anarchists with individual freedom as a fundamental value, their goal is the destruction of any state system. They refuse the principle of hierarchy, preferring self-management. This faction, particularly sensitive to the feminist cause, considers patriarchy as the basis of all problems in society and will do everything to fight it.
LanguageData.Anarchiste_communiste.label: Anarcho-communists
LanguageData.Anarchiste_communiste.description: Anarcho-communists place material equality above all other principles as the foundation of their ideology. For an anarcho-communist, to be free means to have the same standard of living as all his neighbours.
LanguageData.australia.label: Australia
LanguageData.australia.description: Australia is a country in the southern hemisphere whose area covers most of Oceania. The country is known for the Sydney Opera House, the Great Barrier Reef, its vast wilderness and desert called the Outback, and its unique animal species such as the kangaroo and the platypus.
LanguageData.bresil.label: Brazil
LanguageData.bresil.description: Brazil, a vast country in South America, stretches from the Amazon basin in the north to the Iguaçu Falls in the south. The city of Rio de Janeiro, characterized by its statue of Christ the Redeemer located at the top of Corcovado, is famous for its much-cited beaches of Copacabana and Ipanema, as well as for its enormous lively carnival, with parades of floats, flamboyant costumes, samba music and dance.
LanguageData.britain.label: United-Kingdom
LanguageData.britain.description: The United Kingdom is a state that includes England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland. England, birthplace of Shakespeare and the Beatles, includes London as its capital, financial and cultural center with global influence, also known for its telephone boxes and red double-decker buses.
LanguageData.canada.label: Canada
LanguageData.canada.description: Canada is a North American country located between the United States to the south and the Arctic Circle to the north. It is the 2nd largest country in the world in terms of area, it has 48 national parks and reserves, and is also home to the famous and majestic Niagara Falls.
LanguageData.chine.label: China
LanguageData.chine.description: The People's Republic of China is a communist state in East Asia. 3rd country by surface area, it is the most populated country in the world with 1.4 billion inhabitants. The iconic Great Wall of China divides the north of the country from east to west.
LanguageData.chretiens.label: Christians
LanguageData.chretiens.description: Christians adhere to the religion descended from Jesus of Nazareth, Christianity, and follow his teaching reported by the Gospels.
LanguageData.coree_du_nord.label: North Korea
LanguageData.coree_du_nord.description: The Democratic People's Republic of Korea contrary to its name is a totalitarian regime where everything is decided by its supreme leader. It is the most closed country in the world, the vast majority of the inhabitants being prohibited from leaving the country.
LanguageData.coree_du_sud.label: South Korea
LanguageData.coree_du_sud.description: South Korea, officially the Republic of Korea, is a country in East Asia. It shares one of the most heavily militarized borders in the world with North Korea. It is also known for its rolling, green countryside dotted with cherry trees and centuries-old Buddhist temples, as well as the fishing villages along its coast, its subtropical islands and high-tech cities like Seoul, its capital. The animal representing the country is the tiger.
LanguageData.ecolos.label: Ecologists
LanguageData.ecolos.description: A group of militant ecologists for the preservation of the environment and respect for nature.
LanguageData.ecolos_radicaux.label: Radical ecologists
LanguageData.ecolos_radicaux.description: A group of radical environmentalists. Defending the environment like classic ecologists, the radicals are distinguished by their proselytism and their ability to use violence to impose their ideas.\nThey also go further in their fight for animal rights, refusing to use them in any way, whether eating them or wearing leather or fur.
LanguageData.Antifas.label: Antifascists
LanguageData.Antifas.description: Located on the ultra left of the political scale, the antifascists highlight the physical struggle against the far right groups. Generally operating in anonymity and without formal structure, this movement is characterized in particular by demonstrations and violent actions. His fight has gradually extended to anti-capitalism, the fight against racism, homophobia or police violence.
LanguageData.Skinhead.label: Ultra-right Skinheads
LanguageData.Skinhead.description: Far-right skinheads promote nationalism, neo-fascism, neo-Nazism, as well as ratonnade, anti-Semitism, homophobia, racism, discrimination, anti-communism in ultra-violent ways, ranging from street action to the armed struggle.
LanguageData.KuKluxKlan.label: Ku Klux Klan
LanguageData.KuKluxKlan.description: The Ku Klux Klan is a white supremacist terrorist secret society in the United States founded in the aftermath of the Civil War in 1866. It opposes the abolition of slavery and has set itself the goal of fighting against blacks. Today, the Klan has become a nebula of small groups of activists and terrorists who blend into the landscape of the American far right and alt-right.
LanguageData.terroristes_islamistes.label: Islamists terrorists
LanguageData.terroristes_islamistes.description: The objective of Islamist terrorism is the promotion of a radical religious vision of the world. Groups like Al-Qaeda or the self-proclaimed Islamic State use Islamism, an extremist vision of Islam, to justify their acts of violence in order to generate a climate of terror within a society.
LanguageData.femen.label: Femen
LanguageData.femen.description: The Femen are a feminist movement created in Ukraine. The activists of this organization defend women's rights and are known for their provocative actions, often topless. The activists of Femen are followers of a radical feminism which they call “sextremism”. The Femen movement asserts itself as atheist and anti-religious.
LanguageData.france.label: France
LanguageData.france.description: France is a Western European country, it has medieval towns, alpine villages and beaches. Paris, its capital, is famous for its fashion houses, classical art museums and monuments like the Eiffel Tower. The country is also renowned for its wines and fine cuisine.
LanguageData.Gilets_jaunes.label: Yellow vests
LanguageData.Gilets_jaunes.description: Symbols of a downgraded population, the yellow vests have gathered on the roundabouts to protest against inflation and government measures, they do not like to receive orders.
LanguageData.israel.label: Israel
LanguageData.israel.description: Israel is a country in the Middle East bordering the Mediterranean Sea, considered since its creation in 1948 as the home of the Jews. For Jews, Christians and Muslims, it is the Holy Land, its holiest sites are in Jerusalem. Since its creation, the State of Israel has repeatedly clashed with neighboring Arab countries, which means that it has very bad relations with Muslims.
LanguageData.juifs.label: Jews
LanguageData.juifs.description: Jews are members of a people linked to their own religion, Judaism and, in the broad sense of the word, to an ethnicity even if not religious.
LanguageData.Mafia.label: Italian Mafia
LanguageData.Mafia.description: The Italian Mafia is a criminal organization born in Sicily and which imposed itself through intimidation, violence and corruption. Today, it represents a formidable international financial group, basing its fortune mainly on drug trafficking and racketeering. Mafia organizations are led by a godfather who commands several small clandestine associations made up of many mafia.
LanguageData.Yakuzas.label: Yakuzas
LanguageData.Yakuzas.description: The Yakuza are members of a Japanese organized criminal group. They would be the largest organized crime organization without being secret. Thus, the clans generally have a storefront, most of the time under cover of a legal structure of the associative type.
LanguageData.mexique.label: Mexico
LanguageData.mexique.description: Located between the United States and Central America, Mexico is a country renowned for its beaches on the Pacific and the Gulf of Mexico, as well as for its varied landscapes - between mountains, deserts and jungles. It is filled with ancient ruins like Teotihuacan and the Mayan city of Chichén Itzá as well as cities dating back to Spanish colonial times. Mexico is also a dangerous country where many cartels operate for dominance in drug trafficking.
LanguageData.Moines_bouddhistes.label: Buddhists monks
LanguageData.Moines_bouddhistes.description: Buddhist monks observe the Precepts defining a life of renunciation and simplicity, following the teaching of the Buddha.
LanguageData.musulmans.label: Muslims
LanguageData.russie.label: Russia
LanguageData.russie.description: The Russian Federation is the largest country in the world, which has the particularity of extending over two continents, Europe for a little less than a quarter (where its capital Moscow is located) and Asia for a little more than remaining three-quarters.
LanguageData.suede.label: Sweden
LanguageData.suede.description: Sweden is a Scandinavian country made up of vast boreal forests and glacial mountains.
LanguageData.suisse.label: Switzerland
LanguageData.suisse.description: Switzerland is a Central European country known for its geopolitical neutrality and banks, and more pleasantly for its ski resorts, jewelry, and chocolate. Its inhabitants are among the richest in the world.
LanguageData.ukraine.label: Ukraine
LanguageData.ukraine.description: Ukraine is a country in Eastern Europe which became independent following the break-up of the Soviet Union.
LanguageData.usa.label: United States of America
LanguageData.usa.description: The United States is a country made up of 50 states and covering a large portion of North America, with Alaska to the northwest and Hawaii extending the country's presence into the Pacific Ocean. They are the world's leading military power.
